articles.title: Galaxy drops CLARITY Act odds to 60% as time is running out
articles.snippet: Galaxy Digital says the Senate has a tight calendar ahead of the November elections, and the time needed to fix up and pass a key crypto bill is quickly fading.

articles.title: What is Zcash (ZEC)? The Privacy Coin Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs
articles.snippet: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that enables users to hide key details of transactions by leveraging zk-SNARKs.

articles.title: Zcash Bug Crisis Shows Privacy Cuts Both Ways, Experts Say
articles.snippet: Fallout from a bug that enabled undetectable Zcash counterfeiting shows that privacy can sometimes present tradeoffs, experts say.
